   - Use Istio outlier detection (option B) for containment, not readiness-on-Redis: "I do not want a Redis blip to take every pod out of rotation at once."
   - Cap the per-worker Redis pool (option B) rather than just raising maxclients: "We keep adding replicas and I do not want to rediscover this every time the HPA scales."
   - Check whether the EU cluster (prod-eu-west-1) runs the same worker count.
   - Park the payments-vendor retry-storm notification question for the postmortem.
   - User filed SRE-3308 for the readiness gap and on-call log access (follow-ups already tracked).
2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Helm release history/rollback; pending-upgrade release record stored as Secret `sh.helm.release.v1.<name>.v<N>`.
   - Gunicorn workers (UvicornWorker), per-worker redis-py connection pools; connection budget rule: workers × poolMaxConnections × autoscaling.maxReplicas < Redis maxclients.
   - Redis `maxclients`, `max number of clients reached`, single-threaded/memory-per-client cost; redis_connected_clients / redis_rejected_connections_total metrics.
   - SLO burn-rate alerting (1h burn rate 14.6x vs 14.4x page threshold; 30d budget remaining 72%).
   - Kubernetes readiness/liveness probes; unconditional `/readyz` = no containment.
   - Istio: ingress gateway `UF,URX` / errno 111 connection refused; sidecar admin `localhost:15000/clusters`; DestinationRule outlierDetection (consecutive5xxErrors, baseEjectionTime, maxEjectionPercent) and connectionPool.
   - EndpointSlice vs Envoy cluster endpoint comparison; Service port mapping (6390 → targetPort 6379).
   - Argo CD deploys from main / branch to staging; gh PR checks (lint, unit, helm-lint, staging-deploy, staging-smoke).

   - deploy/helm/session-store/templates/configmap.yaml
     - Line 31 `maxclients 256` with comment "Sized for the original 4-worker gateway deployment." Redis on port 6379; sentinel config present.
